links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of LLM responses to patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT FRE 48.5, FKGL 11.94; Gemini most complex, FRE 29.9, FKGL 13.3; reading levels above plain-language level.
links.quote: Readability varied between models: ChatGPT responses were easiest to understand (FRE = 48.5; FKGL = 11.94), while Gemini's were the most complex (FRE = 29.9; FKGL = 13.3).

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM patient-facing responses
links.effect: FKGL 11.94 (ChatGPT) to 13.3 (Gemini), FRE 29.9-48.5, well above typical patient reading level.
links.quote: Readability varied between models: ChatGPT responses were easiest to understand (FRE = 48.5; FKGL = 11.94), while Gemini's were the most complex (FRE = 29.9; FKGL = 13.3).

links.outcome: Rate of misleading or incomplete LLM responses rated by urologists
links.effect: 14% of responses flagged as potentially misleading or incomplete; Gemini accuracy 4.3, hallucination score 4.6.
links.quote: Overall, 14% of responses were flagged as potentially misleading or incomplete.

screen.reason: The study evaluates standard commercial LLMs answering simulated patient questions about incidental kidney tumors, scored by urologists for accuracy, readability, and safety, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
